payload.reason: The evidence describes the use of various features in a machine learning model to analyze IRA trolls on Twitter, indicating that the features were used in a machine learning context.

claims.text: The features used were part of a machine learning model designed to detect IRA trolls on Twitter.
The model utilized textual features, including emotional and sentiment analysis, to capture changes in users' tweets.
The model incorporated bias cues and linguistic categories to analyze the content of tweets.
